title: Aide personnalisée au logement (APL): eligibility by household size and floor area

source.entry_point: Aides_logement scope ÉligibilitéAidePersonnaliséeLogement, output éligibilité (Python: generated.Aides_logement.eligibilite_aide_personnalisee_logement, Catala 1.3.0)

attributes.name: nationalite_demandeur
attributes.source: Demandeur.nationalité (aides_logement/prologue.catala_fr:228-247); read by L822-2 I (aides_logement/code_construction_legislatif.catala_fr:130-136) and its Mayotte version L861-5 1° (aides_logement/code_construction_legislatif.catala_fr:1389-1400)

attributes.name: situation_familiale
attributes.source: Ménage.situation_familiale, enumeration SituationFamiliale (aides_logement/code_construction_legislatif.catala_fr:107-117); read by R822-25 (aides_logement/code_construction_reglementaire.catala_fr:1015-1058) and R861-5 3° (5614-5645)

attributes.name: personnes_a_charge
attributes.source: Ménage.personnes_à_charge (aides_logement/prologue.catala_fr:217-226), counted by `nombre de ménage.personnes_à_charge` in R822-25 (aides_logement/code_construction_reglementaire.catala_fr:1016-1028, 1042-1045) and R861-5 3° (5629-5632)

attributes.name: surface_m_carres
attributes.source: Logement.surface_m_carrés (aides_logement/prologue.catala_fr:163-171), compared by R822-25 (aides_logement/code_construction_reglementaire.catala_fr:1029-1058), R844-4 (5531-5545) and R861-5 3° for Mayotte (5614-5645)

every ménage and demandeur field that is.value: as in the official test Exemple1 (aides_logement/tests/tests_eligibilite_apl.catala_fr:16-107): date_courante |2020-03-10|, résidence Métropole, Mariés |2010-11-26|, three EnfantÀCharge (born 2001-01-01 Après with études, 2009-01-01 Pendant, 2012-01-01 Pendant; French, 0 € pay, no shared custody, a_déjà_ouvert_droit_aux_allocations_familiales vrai), prestations [AllocationSoutienEnfantHandicapé; ComplémentFamilial; AllocationsFamiliales], 1 other occupant, Locataire of a BailleurSocial conventionné (loyer 750 €, RLS 0 €, every other Location boolean faux, PasDeChangement), Zone1, résidence principale, décent, 80 m², propriétaire Autre, usufruit Autre, not let to third parties, no IFI, no unborn child, not R844-4; demandeur born 1970-05-02, Française, with every other boolean faux
every ménage and demandeur field that is.why: keeps the official test Exemple1 on the table (date_courante |2020-03-10|); dependants are the first k children of Exemple1 so that k = 3 reproduces the test exactly

notes: Sub-table 2 of 5 of FR-APL (amount computation out of scope). The floor-area bands are cut at every minimum area the code can compare against for the household sizes in the table (2 to 6 persons with a couple, 1 to 5 with a single adult); the caps of R822-25 (70 m² from 8 persons) and of the Mayotte rule (54 m² from 9 persons) are out of reach with these sizes. REJECTED rows: in Mayotte the Mayotte surface rule and R844-4 are both exceptions to the same base rule and conflict (CONVERSION.md).
